title: Growth & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
Growth & Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Manchester, UK Full-time, in-person

Salary depending on experience, plus performance bonus

We are a community-driven technology platform for the promotional products industry, bringing together 2,300+ distributor members, brand partners and modern merch sellers.

At the heart of the business is our AI-first platform, built to make running a promotional products business faster and easier. From sourcing and live inventory to mock-ups, artwork and intelligent business tools, we are building technology around the way this industry actually works.

We are growing. And we need someone who understands how to turn that growth opportunity into something measurable.

What this role is

We are looking for an experienced growth and lifecycle marketer who knows how to make sure strong marketing reaches the right people, through the right channels, at the right moment.

You will own the machinery behind that.

That means understanding our audiences, segmenting them properly in HubSpot, building email and CRM journeys, distributing campaigns and using data to continually improve acquisition, activation, engagement and retention.

You will work closely with our Brand & Culture Strategist and content team, who own how we sound and the creative direction of our marketing.

They create the signal. You make sure it reaches the right people, and prove whether it worked.

Your non-negotiables

This role requires:
- 3+ years in growth, lifecycle or performance-led marketing, ideally within SaaS, a platform or marketplace business.
- Demonstrable, hands-on HubSpot experience, including lists, segmentation, workflows, email campaigns, lifecycle stages, automation and reporting.
- Strong email and CRM marketing experience, including audience segmentation, behavioural targeting, nurture journeys, testing and optimisation.
- Strong analytical ability, with experience using campaign performance, CRM data, funnels and customer behaviour to make decisions.
- Proven ownership of acquisition AND retention, with evidence of bringing people in, moving them towards conversion and keeping them engaged.

These are the foundations of the role.

What you would actually be doing

You will build the infrastructure and strategy for reaching our audiences properly.

You will own HubSpot as a marketing tool, creating meaningful audience segments, maintaining lifecycle logic, building automated journeys and making sure CRM data informs our marketing.

You will build and optimise email programmes around behaviour and decide how campaigns should be distributed across email, paid, organic, partner, event and community channels.

You will map the journey from first interaction through sign-up, activation, engagement, conversion and retention, identifying where people move forward and where we lose them.

You will measure what happens. Not just opens, clicks and impressions, but whether marketing changed behaviour.

And you will bring those findings back into the business: what worked, what didn't and what we should do differently next time.

The audiences you will be working with

Our audiences range from owner-operators and established distributors with sales teams to individual reps, suppliers and brand partners.

Different people. Different behaviours. Different reasons to care.

Your job is to understand those differences and make sure our marketing reflects them.

Because good marketing sent to the wrong person is still the wrong marketing.

Acquisition is only half the job

Getting someone through the door matters. What happens afterwards matters just as much.

For our platform, that means understanding the journey from discovery and sign-up through to first use, returning, exploring more of the platform and ultimately making it part of how they work.

For our wider community, it means understanding what keeps members engaged and where we can deepen that relationship.

How you work

You are naturally curious about the numbers behind the marketing. You want to know why one audience responded and another didn't, why people signed up but never came back and why one segment converts differently from another.

You are comfortable getting into HubSpot yourself to find out.

You test, learn and adjust rather than relying on assumptions, turning information into clear decisions about what happens next.

AI is part of how we work

Our platform is AI-first and we want our marketing function to work with the same mindset.

You should already be comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or equivalent, and be curious about how AI can make segmentation, analysis, research, automation and marketing operations smarter.

What the business is like

This is an established company with real infrastructure, industry relationships and a large existing community, backed by a listed group. But we are building quickly.

You will work closely with brand, content, product, technology, sales and our US team.

This is an in-person role because that proximity matters. Most of our members are in North America, so there will occasionally be later finishes to overlap with our US team and community, as well as opportunities to travel to industry events in the US and UK.

Alongside salary, the role includes a performance bonus linked to growth and engagement.

How to apply

Send us your CV.

We will be looking for evidence of hands-on HubSpot experience, email and CRM marketing, audience segmentation, analytical decision-making and measurable acquisition and retention results.

You do not need a particular degree or a perfectly linear career. You do need to be able to show us what you have actually done.

This role is based in Manchester and requires you to be Manchester-based and able to work from the office. Remote applications will not be considered.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship.

title: Marketing Manager (Commercial)
description:
Marketing Manager, Commercial Property

Manchester, five days in the office with sensible flexibility, regular UK travel

Salary, £37,000 to £45,000 DOE

MCR Property Group is growing its commercial property portfolio and investing in the buildings, workspaces and teams behind it. Recent activity includes the acquisition of 4 M at Manchester Airport and Headrow House in Leeds, with further growth planned across offices, flexible workspace, industrial and mixed use assets.

We are now launching a new dedicated national commercial property brand, supported by a fresh dedicated marketing team focused entirely on the sector.

We are looking for a Marketing Manager to join that team and support the Head of Marketing, Commercial Property in building the brand, launching assets, generating demand and supporting leasing across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role with the opportunity to join at the beginning, help shape how the new brand goes to market and play a direct part in building the marketing operation behind it.

The objective is simple: attract the right occupiers, generate more qualified enquiries and viewings, support agents and leasing teams, and help reduce the time that space sits empty.

The role

You will help manage the day to day marketing of our commercial portfolio, understanding what is available, who it is suitable for, what competing buildings are offering and how each asset should be positioned.

You will turn that understanding into campaigns across property portals, paid media, search, social, email, direct marketing, PR and agent communications.

You will support the launch of our new national commercial brand across websites, campaigns, signage, property marketing, occupier communications and new acquisitions.

You will also help establish the new dedicated commercial marketing team, working alongside the Head of Marketing as the function develops and grows.

You will have access to MCR Property Group's established in house studio, CRM team, digital specialists and wider marketing management resource, giving the new commercial team the capability to move quickly and deliver high quality work internally.

What you will be responsible for
- Managing day to day marketing plans across a portfolio of commercial properties
- Supporting the launch and growth of the new national commercial property brand
- Helping build the marketing processes, standards and ways of working for the new dedicated commercial team
- Delivering campaigns designed to generate qualified enquiries and property viewings
- Managing property listings, websites and landing pages, ensuring content, availability, imagery and enquiry routes are accurate and effective
- Supporting acquisition launches, refurbishment campaigns and asset repositioning
- Briefing photography, video, CGI, Matterport and other property content
- Working with the in house studio on brochures, presentations, signage, hoardings, digital creative and agent materials
- Working with the CRM team to improve lead capture, tracking, follow up and reporting
- Monitoring campaign performance, enquiry levels, viewing activity and lead quality
- Supporting paid search, paid social, email marketing and digital acquisition activity
- Coordinating agent campaigns, events, property updates and occupier communications
- Supporting PR around acquisitions, lettings, refurbishments and portfolio growth
- Managing external suppliers where required
- Supporting marketing budgets and ensuring spend is directed towards activity that produces results

Commercial focus

This is a marketing role that sits close to leasing.

We want someone who is interested in what happens after a campaign goes live.

Did it generate enquiries, were they the right enquiries, did they become viewings, did the viewings progress, what did the agents say, what should we change

You will regularly review enquiry levels, viewing activity, conversion, occupancy, campaign performance, agent feedback and marketing spend.

You do not need to be a surveyor, but you should want to understand the commercial side of property and the impact marketing has on leasing.

Every empty unit has a cost, your role is to help create demand around it.

About you

You will have strong marketing experience and be ready to take greater ownership of campaigns, assets and performance.

Your background may be in commercial property, real estate, workspace, placemaking, hospitality or another sector where marketing is used to generate demand for physical space.

You will be organised, commercially minded and confident managing multiple projects at once.

You will understand digital marketing, campaign management, content, CRM and lead generation.

You will have strong written communication skills and be comfortable briefing creative teams, photographers, agencies and suppliers.

You will be confident working with senior stakeholders and external agents, and comfortable looking at performance data and making decisions from it.

Most importantly, you will care about the outcome of the work, not simply whether the campaign was delivered.

What success looks like

Success will mean a strong launch for the new national commercial brand, more qualified enquiries, more property viewings, stronger digital conversion, better asset launches, improved agent engagement, clearer CRM data, better marketing materials and more efficient spend.

It will also mean helping establish a dedicated commercial marketing team that can scale with the portfolio and support the next stage of growth.

Working pattern

The role is based in Manchester and is primarily office based, five days a week, with sensible flexibility where required.

Regular travel across the UK portfolio is part of the role. You will visit properties, meet agents, work with site teams and understand local markets first hand.

Commercial property is a physical product, and the best marketing comes from understanding the buildings properly.

description:
Social Media Manager - Flow Student

Location: Manchester office-based, with travel across the Flow Student portfolio when required

Reporting to: Head of Marketing

About Flow Student:

We're already home to students across some of the UK's best university cities, including Liverpool, Sheffield, Coventry, Nottingham, Sunderland, Canterbury, Bradford and Preston. With major refurbishment projects continuing across the portfolio, we're upgrading our spaces and preparing them for students joining us.

Our proposition is straightforward: student living that flows around you.

Launched in late 2025, Flow Student is a brand-new brand and one of the UK's fastest-growing student accommodation providers, offering affordable, well-designed student accommodation across some of the UK's best university cities.

We're building a more distinctive, commercially effective student accommodation brand. Social media will be a huge part of how we build that brand, connect with students and turn attention into enquiries and bookings.

That's where you come in.

The Role:

We're looking for a Social Media Manager who understands that great social media is about much more than posting content.

You'll own the day-to-day social presence of Flow Student, developing content and communities that feel genuinely relevant to students and culturally in tune with the platforms they use.

You'll need to be deeply immersed in Gen Z trends, behaviours, language, creators, formats and online culture. You'll know what is gaining traction, understand why it works, and - importantly - know when a trend is right for Flow Student and when it isn't.

One day you might be developing a TikTok around a student-life trend. The next, you could be briefing a creator, filming content at one of our properties, responding to comments, analysing performance or turning a resident story into a piece of content that travels across Instagram and TikTok. A key part of this role will also be developing engaging content, aimed at generating enquiries, leads and ultimately sales.

You'll work closely with the marketing team, property teams, the design team and residents to make Flow Student a brand students recognise, engage with and want to be part of.

This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone who can spot the opportunity, create the content, publish it, engage the audience and understand the numbers behind it.

What you will be responsible for:
- Owning the Flow Student organic social media strategy across relevant platforms, with a particular focus on TikTok and Instagram.
- Developing and maintaining an engaging social media calendar aligned to brand, commercial and booking priorities.
- Creating, commissioning and publishing social-first content that feels native to each platform rather than repurposed advertising.
- Staying relentlessly close to Gen Z trends, online culture, creators, memes, formats, sounds and emerging behaviours, identifying opportunities for Flow Student.
- Turning trends into relevant Flow Student content quickly, while ensuring the brand remains authentic and recognisable.
- Developing recurring social formats, series and content pillars that build familiarity and engagement over time.
- Capturing content across our properties, including student life, facilities, events, local areas, room tours, resident experiences and behind-the-scenes moments.
- Working with residents and student creators to produce credible, relatable content about life at Flow Student.
- Supporting and developing the Flow Creators programme, helping residents become confident and effective brand advocates. Building relationships with creators and managing collaborations from brief through to delivery and reporting.
- Monitoring conversations, trends and competitor activity to understand what students are talking about and where Flow Student can participate meaningfully.
- Working closely with property teams to uncover local stories, student insights, events and content opportunities.
- Collaborating with designers, photographers, videographers and external agencies to produce high-quality social content.
- Supporting integrated campaigns across paid social, email, website and other marketing channels, ensuring social plays a meaningful role.
- Working with the wider marketing team to align social activity with key booking periods, including early booking, international recruitment, January intake, Clearing and late availability.
- Tracking engagement, reach, audience growth, content performance, enquiries and other relevant metrics.
- Producing concise reports and recommendations that turn social data into action.
- Managing social content calendars, deadlines, approvals and asset libraries so content reaches the audience at the right time.
- Occasionally preparing content for the corporate Linkedin page, relating to Flow Student news.

What success looks like:

We will look at whether:
- Flow Student has a distinctive, recognisable and engaging presence across its social channels.
- Our content feels genuinely relevant to students rather than like traditional accommodation advertising.
- Clear understanding of commercial performance.
- You consistently identify emerging Gen Z trends and turn the right ones into opportunities for the brand.
- Social content is delivered quickly, consistently and to a high standard.
- The Flow Student community is growing and becoming increasingly engaged.
- Residents and creators are producing credible content that students actually want to watch and share.
- Social activity contributes meaningfully to awareness, enquiries and ultimately bookings.
- You continually test, learn and improve rather than simply repeating what worked last time.
- You use performance data to make better creative and commercial decisions.
- You proactively identify opportunities rather than waiting to be told what to post.
- Flow Student

What You'll Bring

- The ability to manage and develop a direct report through clear direction, coaching and constructive feedback.

A degree or professional qualification is not essential for this position.

You'll:
- Optimise the digital customer journey: Use customer behaviour, feedback and performance data to improve journeys across app and web, from onboarding and menu exploration through to checkout and post-purchase interactions.
- Turn insight into better experiences: Work with Product, UX, Research, Data and Technology teams on experimentation, CRO and UX priorities, making sure customer discovery and testing inform delivery.
- Strengthen execution and performance: Oversee onsite campaigns, content and promotional activity; maintain accurate product information; track digital and customer-journey KPIs; and improve processes that prevent broken journeys or recurring errors.

You'll also contribute to the wider digital experience strategy, provide clear recommendations to senior stakeholders and help align teams around the improvements that matter most to customers and the business.
How We Will Support You
Bring your flavour, and we'll back your future. This role gives you the space to build your digital expertise, develop your leadership skills and influence work that reaches customers across Domino's digital channels.
Here's what you can expect:
- A clear induction, with the context and support you need to understand our digital ecosystem, priorities and ways of working.
- Support from your manager and the wider team, alongside the autonomy to use your judgement and shape how digital-experience improvements are delivered.
- Opportunities to broaden your strategic exposure by working across Product, UX, Data, Marketing, CRM, Operations and Technology.
- Support to grow as a people manager, helping you give clear direction, develop talent and create consistently high standards.
- Recognition for great work, from everyday appreciation to wider moments such as our Domi Awards.

Our employer brand is built around growth, belonging, recognition, wellbeing and giving people space to shape their role with support to succeed.

We celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, regardless of their identity, background, or any other characteristic. When you join our team, you join a family that welcomes and celebrates authenticity!
Our recipe for success? Our DomiDNA:
- We Mean Business
- We Always Deliver
- We're Open to New Flavours
- We're Tastier Together

If you share our values and are ready to be part of a world-class team that's as passionate about people as we are about pizza, apply now and join the Domino's UK & Ireland family!

5. Performance, Reporting & ROI

Candidate Requirements

Our client is looking for a proactive marketer who combines creative execution with sharp commercial awareness.

Essential Criteria

- Content & Copywriting: Strong writing abilities with a knack for turning technical concepts into clear B2 B copy.
- Digital & Social Expertise: Hands-on experience using LinkedIn for B2 B lead generation, along with email marketing tools and digital campaigns.

- Commercial Mindset: Understanding of marketing analytics, ROI tracking, and how marketing fuels sales pipelines.
- Career Ambition: Clear desire to progress into a Marketing Manager role over time.

Desirable Criteria
- Prior experience or exposure to R&D Tax Relief, engineering, construction, M&E, or technical consultancy.
- Exposure to UK professional services or US market expansion initiatives.
- Familiarity with CRM systems, marketing automation, Google Analytics, SEO, or LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

Strategic Career Progression

Our client is committed to investing in your long-term growth through a defined multi-stage career path:
- Initial Phase (Marketing Associate): Establish a consistent marketing presence, master core messaging, and take charge of content delivery across all active channels.
- Development Phase (Strategic Ownership): Expand into campaign strategy, market research, brand positioning, and international expansion efforts.
- Leadership Phase (Marketing Manager): Step into a Marketing Manager role, taking full ownership of group marketing strategy, budgets, and team expansion.

Why Apply Through Us for This Role?
- Direct Access: Work closely with senior leadership without getting bogged down in corporate red tape.
- Multi-Sector Exposure: Broaden your portfolio across two high-demand, high-value consultancy sectors.
- Real Career Track: Join a company that actively wants to fast-track you into a management position.

How to Apply

title: Marketing Communications Executive
description:
Job Description

We're looking for a Marketing Communications Executive to join our Marketing team and help shape how financial advisers experience AJ Bell. You'll create clear, engaging campaigns that help advisers understand our proposition, connect with AJ Bell and ultimately help more people feel good about investing.

It's a varied, hands-on role where you'll work across email, social media, web, CRM, webinars and events, taking campaigns from idea through to delivery and using data and insight to continually improve their impact.

What does the job involve?

Working with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Product, Investments and Technical, you'll:
- Plan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns that drive adviser awareness, engagement, leads and registrations.
- Create targeted email campaigns, nurture programmes and automated customer journeys using HubSpot.
- Develop audience segmentation and personalisation to make our communications more relevant and effective.
- Create engaging social media content across LinkedIn, YouTube and X, working with internal experts and external contributors.
- Develop and optimise adviser-facing webpages, landing pages and digital content.
- Support the promotion of webinars, events and other adviser initiatives.
- Use campaign, CRM, website and social data to understand what's working and identify opportunities to improve performance.
- Use A/B testing, behavioural insight and audience data to test ideas and optimise campaigns.
- Produce reporting and performance insight, turning data into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
- Work closely with our Design and Distribution teams to maximise the reach and impact of campaigns.
- Use AI-powered tools, including Microsoft Copilot, to support research, planning, content creation, reporting and optimisation.
- Make sure marketing activity is accurate, high quality and delivered in line with AJ Bell's governance, regulatory and Consumer Duty requirements.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who enjoys combining creativity with data and has experience delivering marketing activity across a range of channels.

You'll have:
- Experience delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- A good understanding of campaign management, audience segmentation, lead generation and performance measurement.
- Experience using CRM and marketing automation platforms, ideally HubSpot.
- Experience working with social media platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube and X.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, engaging content for different audiences.
- An analytical mindset and the ability to turn campaign data into practical recommendations.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- The confidence to build relationships and work collaboratively with stakeholders across the business.
- An interest in using technology and AI to find smarter and more effective ways of working.

Experience with HTML and content management systems such as Drupal would be useful, but isn't essential.

If you're a marketer who enjoys creating great campaigns, experimenting with new ideas and using insight to make them better, we'd love to hear from you.

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

What we offer
- Competitive starting salary depending on experience
- 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
- 6% Pension with matched contributions
- Discretionary bonus scheme
- Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
- Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
- Free onsite gym
- Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
- Travel and bike loan schemes
- Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell
- Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
- Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
- Casual dress code
- Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there's an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

Inclusion & diversity

We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

title: Senior Paid Media Executive
description:
Senior Paid Media Executive - Fast-growing fashion brand
- Salary - Upto £38k
- Location - Manchester
- 50% staff discount
- Payday events
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

Zachary Daniels are partnered with a fast-growing founder-led premium womenswear brand with a strong presence in the UK and an increasingly global customer base.

The Role:

We're looking for a highly hands-on Paid Media Manager to take ownership of our paid media strategy, performance and day-to-day execution across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and Pinterest. This is a key role within the business, sitting at the heart of our commercial, creative and e-commerce teams.

Key Responsibilities:
- Own the day-to-day management of paid media across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and Pinterest.
- Build, launch, manage and optimise campaigns across Paid Social, Search, Shopping and Performance Max.
- Manage budgets and pacing in line with revenue, ROAS, CPA and wider trading targets.
- Monitor key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, MER, CTR, CPC, CVR, CPM and revenue.
- Identify performance issues and take action across budgets, bidding, audiences, creative, placements and campaign structure.
- Translate trading priorities including new launches, new-in, best sellers, seasonal moments and promotions into effective paid media campaigns.
- Analyse product and category performance to identify opportunities to scale or reduce investment.
- Partner closely with E-commerce and Creative teams to align paid activity with commercial priorities.
- Work closely with Creative, Influencer and UGC teams to develop high-performing, platform-native paid creative.
- Analyse performance across creative concepts, hooks, formats, creators, messaging, products and offers.
- Own weekly and monthly paid media reporting.
- Clearly communicate performance, insights, challenges and recommended actions.
- Analyse data across advertising platforms, GA4, Shopify and blended business metrics.

About You:
- 3+ years' hands-on paid media experience, ideally within e-commerce.
- Strong experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads.
- Experience across additional paid social channels, particularly TikTok and Pinterest.
- Proven experience managing multiple paid channels independently.
- Experience managing meaningful paid media budgets against ROAS, CPA and revenue targets.

Why Apply:
- Own the Paid Media function - take full ownership of strategy, performance and day-to-day execution.
- Real autonomy - make decisions, test ideas and shape the paid media strategy without layers of sign-off.
- Significant commercial impact - directly influence revenue, customer acquisition and profitable growth.
- Multi-channel ownership - work across Meta, Google, TikTok and Pinterest.
- Shape creative strategy - work closely with Creative, UGC and Influencer teams to develop high-performing campaigns.
